programs.title: Worker Voice in AI Governance: A Moscone.X Workshop
outcomes: Explain how an agent-managed, human-governed DAO separates agent operations from human-reserved decisions
Draft a proposal outline for the Proposal Forum on AI's impact on workers
Identify which governance actions are reserved exclusively for humans

sessions.activity: Read the charter wall; map the mission to members' workplaces and list which decisions stay human-reserved.
Guided by Evidence Monitor outputs, compare claims about workplace AI and rank evidence quality in small groups.
Draft a one-page proposal with the Proposal & Grant Drafter's template; peers debate but agents never enact.
Review measurable-outcome tracking from a mock decision cycle and agree on indicators for the next workshop cohort.

programs.data_shared: Anonymized proposal topics and vote-debate themes (no names, employers, or bargaining positions) contributed to the shared synthesis models.
programs.consent: Members opt in per workshop; shop stewards review data-sharing terms; any member may withdraw contributions at any time with deletion honored.

programs.title: Agents and Allies: Governing AI at Moscone.X
outcomes: Describe the difference between what AI agents may do and what only people may decide
Compare the five zones of the world and their purposes
Write a simple charter rule with a measurable outcome

sessions.activity: Scavenger hunt matching charter clauses to zone purposes; students flag which actions need a human vote.
Students act as junior Evidence Monitors: summarize a short article and separate fact from opinion.
Teams draft a class proposal using the drafter template and hold a real vote with everyone counting equally.
Build a paper progress tracker with one measurable outcome and check it against the class proposal results.

programs.data_shared: Anonymized class proposal texts and voting tallies only; no names, ages, or identifying details are stored.
programs.consent: Signed guardian/parent consent forms required before participation and before any data sharing; teachers collect forms, guardians may opt out of data contribution while students still participate, and all data is deleted after the term.

programs.title: Evidence-to-Decision Lab for Civil Society Teams
outcomes: Adapt the agent-managed DAO model to a civil-society decision cycle
Practice evidence synthesis with agent summaries and human judgment
Design measurable outcomes for a policy campaign

sessions.activity: Compare Evidence Monitor and Research Synthesis Agent outputs; annotate gaps and biases for steward review.
Simulate Task Router coordination: form working groups and hand off scoped tasks between cycles.
Turn a synthesis finding into a drafted proposal; peer review enforces the human-reserved enactment rule.
Draft three measurable outcomes for a real campaign and set a review cadence mirroring the DAO cycle.

programs.data_shared: Anonymized campaign outcome indicators and synthesis annotations, stripped of beneficiary and partner identifiers.
programs.consent: Organizations sign a data-sharing MOU; staff consent individually; beneficiaries' data is never contributed, and any partner may suspend sharing.

programs.title: Grant-Ready by Design: Nonprofit Proposal Practice at Moscone.X
outcomes: Write a clear, measurable proposal using the drafter template
Explain why enactment and treasury decisions remain human-reserved
Track program outcomes with simple indicators

sessions.activity: Map the mission statement to the nonprofit's own mission; identify shared 'public good' language.
Use the Proposal & Grant Drafter to outline a grant request; groups critique drafts against a rubric.
Route follow-up tasks to working groups; practice the Collaborator Scout's expert-mapping method on paper.
Define two measurable outcomes and a simple tracking sheet to report back to boards and funders.

programs.data_shared: Anonymized rubric scores and proposal structure patterns; no donor, client, or financial data is ever contributed.
programs.consent: Each organization consents via a plain-language agreement; staff opt in individually; contributions can be withdrawn and removed on request.
